# Khushi Travels

> Khushi Travels offers tempo traveller rentals, group transport, and tour packages from Bengaluru, Karnataka, India.

## About

Khushi Travels serves private groups, families, pilgrims, and organisations travelling from Bengaluru. Services include tempo traveller and bus hire, holiday packages, pilgrimage tours, and weekend getaways.
